headline: Iran Partially Closes Strait Of Hormuz Amid Nuclear Talks With US
summary: Iran has partially closed the Strait of Hormuz while conducting military drills and engaging in nuclear talks with the United States. The report gives no further detail on the scope of the closure.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a major chokepoint through which a large share of the world's seaborne oil passes. Disruptions there can quickly affect global energy prices and shipping costs.
why_moved: The partial closure of a key oil transit route raises concerns about supply disruption. Those concerns tend to lift oil prices and weigh on risk assets.
